## Certxa — Salon Booking Software & POS System for Beauty Businesses
Source: https://certxa.com/

All-in-one salon software

# Run your salon. Effortlessly.
Certxa brings online booking, a salon POS, client management, waitlist, staff payroll, and review tools into one platform — built for nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, massage studios, hair removal studios, and braid and weave salons.
Start free trial See how it works
Free Solo plan · 60-day trial on team plans
As seen on Product Hunt Capterra G2 Online booking

## Your business's own booking webpage.
Every business on Certxa gets a dedicated booking page clients can visit anytime — from your website, a direct link, Google, or Instagram. They pick their service, provider, and time. Automated reminders cut no-shows before they happen.
Learn more Salon POS

## A register built for beauty businesses.
A touch-screen front desk that handles tickets, services, add-ons, tips, split payments, gift cards, and cash — all in one place. Syncs to every client record automatically. Works across multiple stations and keeps running even when the internet goes down.
Learn more Self check-in kiosk

## Clients check themselves in.
A tablet at the front door lets clients check in with their phone number or a QR code, pick their service, and join the queue — no staff needed. Recognizes returning clients and suggests what they are due for. Available in English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean.
Learn more Waitlist management

## Never lose a walk-in again.
When your business is fully booked, Certxa captures walk-ins on a live digital waitlist. The moment a slot opens, the next client is automatically notified and given a one-tap confirmation window — so you fill cancellations instantly without any manual follow-up.
Learn more Turn rotation

## Fair turns, automatically.
Certxa assigns walk-ins to staff members based on rules you set. The turn board shows who is next, who is with a client, and who is on a break — keeping things fair and transparent for the whole team without any manual tracking.
Learn more Loyalty rewards

## Two ways to keep clients coming back.
Choose the loyalty program that fits your business. The digital punch card awards one punch per visit — once a client hits the number you set, a reward is automatically applied at checkout. Or run a points program where clients earn points per dollar spent, redeemable for discounts you define.
Learn more Live — Autumn is answering calls now Autumn AI receptionist

## Salon Booking Software Features — Online Booking, POS & More | Certxa
Source: https://certxa.com/features

Everything you need

# One platform. Every tool your business needs.
Certxa covers the full day at your business — from the first online booking to end-of-day close, payroll, client notifications, waitlist management, and review management. Built for nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, massage studios, hair removal studios, and braid and weave salons.
Start free trial See pricing Online booking

## Clients book online, around the clock.
Give every client a booking page where they pick their service, provider, and time — from any device, any time of day. Clients can book directly from your website, a direct link, Google, or Instagram. Service-specific options like nail length, shape, and design are available for nail salons.
Automated text and email reminders go out before every appointment, and instant confirmations are sent the moment a booking is made. Clients can reschedule from the same confirmation link without calling.
- Service, provider, and time selection
- Service-specific options at booking (e.g. nail length, shape, and design)
- Book from your website, Google, or Instagram
- Automated text and email reminders
- Instant booking confirmations
- Client self-service rescheduling
- Google and Apple Calendar feed
Front desk calendar

## Every team member's day, at a glance.
A live multi-staff calendar gives your whole team instant visibility of every appointment, break, and booking gap. Appointments are color-coded by team member so the front desk can see the full picture in seconds.
Drag and drop to move appointments, block time for breaks and holidays, and print a daily run sheet in one click. Walk-ins appear alongside bookings so nothing falls through the cracks.
- Live multi-staff calendar view
- Color-coded by team member
- Drag-and-drop rescheduling
- Block time for breaks and holidays
- Printable daily run sheets
- Walk-ins alongside bookings
Self check-in kiosk

## Clients check themselves in.
A tablet at the front door lets clients check in with their phone number or a QR code, choose their service, and join the queue without waiting for staff. Service-specific options — like nail length and shape for nail salons, or treatment type for spas and massage studios — are presented at check-in.
The kiosk recognizes returning clients and suggests what they are due for based on their visit history. It prints a check-in slip and works in English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean.
- Check in by phone number or QR code
- Returning client recognition and service suggestions
- Service-specific options at check-in
- Joins queue and prints check-in slip
- English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean
Built-in POS

## Checkout in seconds, not minutes.
A touch-screen POS handles tickets, services, add-ons, discounts, tips, and split payments — all synced instantly to every client record. Accept card payments with a card reader, cash, and gift cards.
Print receipts, open the cash drawer, and close the day with a cash count and printed report. Works across multiple front desk stations and keeps running when the internet goes down.
- Services, add-ons, discounts, and tips in one checkout
- Split payments and gift card redemption
- Tipping prompts on every transaction
- Next-day payouts to your bank
- Syncs to client profiles automatically
- Receipt printing and cash drawer
- Multi-station support
- Offline mode — saves tickets when internet is down
Waitlist management

## Never lose a walk-in again.
When your business is fully booked, Certxa captures walk-ins on a live digital waitlist. The moment a slot opens up, the next client is automatically notified and given a simple confirmation window — so you fill cancellations instantly without any manual follow-up.
Clients on the waitlist can see their estimated wait time, and loyalty members can be given priority. Every walk-in is captured, every slot is filled.
- Live digital waitlist for walk-ins
- Auto-text when a slot opens
- One-tap client confirmation
- Priority bumping for loyalty members
- Estimated wait time display
Client notifications

## The right message, at the right moment.
Certxa handles every client communication automatically — booking confirmations, appointment reminders, rescheduling alerts, waitlist notifications, and post-visit review requests. Clients always know where they stand without your staff making a single call.
When a client is overdue for their next visit, Certxa sends a personalized re-engagement text at exactly the right time — based on their own visit history, not a generic schedule.
- Booking confirmations and reminders via SMS and email
- Rescheduling and cancellation alerts
- Waitlist slot-open notifications
- Post-visit review request texts
- Personalized re-engagement texts for overdue clients
Turn rotation

## Fair turns, automatically.
Certxa assigns walk-ins to staff members automatically based on rules the business sets. The turn board shows who is next, who is with a client, and who is on a break — keeping things fair and transparent for the whole team.
- Automatic turn assignment for walk-ins
- Business-set rotation rules
- Live view of next, busy, and on-break status
Staff, commissions and payroll

## Pay your team accurately, every time.
Set commission rates per staff member and track tips separately. Add recurring deductions the owner sets, run pay periods, and print earnings statements and paychecks.
Every paycheck includes a breakdown of exactly which tickets earned each commission, so there are no disputes and no guesswork.
- Per-staff commission rates
- Tips tracked separately
- Recurring deductions
- Pay periods and earnings statements
- Printed paychecks
- Ticket-level commission breakdown
Clients and loyalty

## Two loyalty programs. One happy client base.
Choose the program that fits your business. The digital punch card awards one punch per visit — once a client reaches the number you set, a reward is automatically applied at checkout. No paper cards, no manual tracking.
Prefer a points-based program? Clients earn points for every dollar they spend. You set the rewards — a dollar-off discount, a free add-on, whatever works for your business. Every client also has a full profile with visit history and preferences, and you can send targeted text campaigns to bring people back during slow periods.
- Digital punch card — one punch per visit, reward at your set threshold
- Points program — clients earn points per dollar spent
- Owner sets all reward values and thresholds
- Rewards automatically applied at checkout when earned
- Client profiles with full visit history and preferences
- Gift cards
- Targeted text message campaigns
Revenue intelligence

## Know exactly where your revenue is going.
Certxa monitors your booking data continuously and surfaces the revenue opportunities your team would otherwise miss. When a client drifts past their usual visit cadence, a personalized re-engagement text goes out automatically — no manual follow-up needed.
See which time slots are consistently underbooked, which staff members have the highest rebooking rates, and which clients are at risk of churning — all in one place. A monthly revenue leakage report shows exactly which lapsed clients represent lost income, with a one-tap option to reach them.
- Client drift detection — auto-texts overdue clients at the right moment
- Monthly revenue leakage report with lapsed client list
- Dead seat intelligence — identifies and helps fill slow time slots
- No-show risk scoring for upcoming appointments
- Rebooking rate by staff member
- Smart cancellation recovery — auto-fills gaps from waitlist and lapsed clients
- Client lifetime value and churn risk scoring
- Business health score — retention, utilization, and rebooking in one number
Review management

## More five-star reviews, on autopilot.
After every visit, Certxa automatically texts the client asking for a review. Happy clients are sent straight to your Google review page. Unhappy clients can reach you privately first, so you can fix problems before they go public.
See all your Google reviews in one place, get alerts for new ones, reply from inside Certxa, and keep your Google Business Profile up to date — including your booking link.
- Automatic post-visit review request by text
- Happy clients directed to Google review page
- Private feedback channel for unhappy clients
- All Google reviews in one place with alerts
- Reply to reviews from inside Certxa
- Google Business Profile kept up to date
Autumn AI receptionist Live now

## Your receptionist, available 24/7.
Autumn answers every call within two seconds — booking new appointments, handling rescheduling and cancellations, answering questions about services and pricing, and upselling add-ons. All without you lifting a finger.
While your salon is open, Autumn sees your live board: who is clocked in, who is with a client, and how many people are waiting. She gives callers a real wait time — not a guess. After hours, she keeps booking and answering questions without implying anyone is in the building.

Start free trial Google Business Profile Instagram Facebook Your website SMS link QR code FAQ

## Common questions about online booking

### Do clients need to download an app to book?
No. Certxa's booking page works in any mobile browser. Clients tap your link and book in under a minute — no app, no account required.

### Can I require a deposit or card on file?
Not yet. Deposits and prepayments at booking are still in development. Today, Certxa protects your time with automated text and email reminders before every appointment.

### How do automated reminders work?
Certxa sends SMS and email reminders at intervals you configure — for example, 48 hours and 2 hours before the appointment. Clients can confirm or cancel directly from the reminder.

### Can clients book with a specific provider?
Yes. Each staff member has their own calendar and availability. Clients can choose their preferred provider or let Certxa assign the next available one.

### What happens when a slot opens up?
Certxa automatically notifies the next client on the waitlist by SMS or email. They can claim the slot with one tap — no manual follow-up needed.

## A receptionist who never puts a caller on hold.
Autumn is deeply integrated with your Certxa account. From the moment she's activated, she knows every service you offer, every staff member's schedule, your business hours, and your booking rules.
Enable for my salon
- Books, reschedules, and cancels appointments in real time
- Knows how busy the salon is right now and gives callers a real wait time
- Tells callers whether a provider is working today, and whether they are free or with a client
- Answers questions about services, prices, and availability
- Upsells add-ons and premium services on every call

Everything Autumn handles

## Everything a great receptionist does, without the overhead.

### Instant answer, every time
Autumn picks up within two seconds, rain or shine. No more missed calls while your providers are mid-service.

### Real-time booking
She sees live availability across all staff and books — or reschedules — directly into your Certxa calendar.

### Built-in upselling
Autumn naturally suggests add-ons and upgrades on every call, increasing your average ticket without any training.

### Client recognition
Returning clients are greeted by name. Autumn knows their history and can pull up their last appointment.

### Follows your rules
Walk-ins only, appointments only, no same-day bookings, a walk-in cutoff — Autumn only offers what your salon actually accepts.

### Live salon awareness
While you're open, Autumn sees who is clocked in, who is free, who is with a client and how many people are waiting — and tells callers the real wait.

### After-hours answering
When the salon is closed Autumn says so, then keeps booking, rescheduling and answering questions. She never pretends someone is in the building.

### Only real answers
Hours, prices, services and wait times come straight from your Certxa account. If Autumn doesn't have a fact, she says so instead of guessing.

### Spam protection
Robocalls, telemarketers, and obvious loops are ended in the first few seconds — so your balance is spent on real clients.

### Natural conversation
Autumn sounds warm, professional, and human. Callers routinely can't tell she isn't your front-desk team.

### Always up to date
Change your services, hours, or staff? Autumn syncs automatically — no retraining required.

### Zero setup friction
Autumn reads your Certxa account from day one. You're live in minutes, not days.
Live salon awareness

## Autumn knows what's happening in your salon right now.
A caller asks "Can I come in now?" A receptionist standing at the front desk would look around before answering. Autumn does the same.

### A real wait time
"There's no wait right now" or "It's about twenty minutes" — worked out from who is in a chair, who is waiting and who is free.

### Who is working today
Autumn knows which providers are clocked in. She won't send a caller in for someone who isn't there.

### Free, busy, or on a break
For each provider she can see whether they're free, with a client or on a break, and roughly when they'll be free next.

### How busy the salon is
Clients in service and clients waiting are counted live, so "we're quiet, come on in" and "we're busy this afternoon" are both true when she says them.

### Your walk-in rules
If you've stopped taking walk-ins, or it's past your walk-in cutoff, Autumn doesn't invite anyone in. She offers an appointment instead.

### Open hours only
Live answers are given while the salon is open. After closing, Autumn tells callers the salon is closed and helps them book for another time.
Up and running in minutes

## Up and running in minutes.
Autumn works with the data already inside your Certxa account. There's nothing to configure from scratch.
1

### Load your account balance
Head to the Autumn section in your Certxa dashboard and add credit to your account. You choose how much to load.
2

### Activate Autumn
Enable Autumn with one click. She reads your services, staff, and calendar automatically — no manual setup.
3

### Forward your calls
Point your salon phone to Autumn's number. She starts answering immediately. Your plan's included calls are used first; after that each call is $0.50 from your balance.
How pricing works

## Pay for what Autumn actually uses.
Autumn is available on every Certxa plan. There's no extra subscription — instead you load funds into your account and Autumn draws from that balance as she handles calls.

### Load your balance
Add any amount to your Autumn credit balance directly from your Certxa dashboard. It pays for calls beyond the ones your plan includes. Funds never expire.

### Autumn handles calls
Your plan covers 20, 50 or 100 calls a month. After that, each call is $0.50 from your balance. Nothing is charged when she's idle.

### Auto top-up (optional)
Set a low-balance threshold and Certxa will top up your account automatically — so Autumn never stops mid-day.
Included in every Certxa plan — 20 calls a month on Solo, 50 on Professional and 100 on Elite. Additional calls are $0.50 each. There is a one-time $15 activation fee for your dedicated phone number, and included calls start once your paid plan begins.
FAQ

## Common questions about Autumn

### Do I need a separate subscription for Autumn?
No. Autumn is included in every Certxa plan: 20 calls a month on Solo, 50 on Professional and 100 on Elite. After that, each additional call is $0.50. There is a one-time $15 activation fee for your dedicated phone number, and included calls start once your paid plan begins.

### How does the credit balance work?
Your plan's included calls are used first. Once they are used up, each additional call is $0.50, taken from the credit balance you top up inside your Certxa dashboard. You can set a low-balance auto top-up so she never goes offline mid-day.

### Does Autumn know how busy my salon is?
Yes. While your salon is open, Autumn sees who is clocked in, who is free, who is with a client and how many people are waiting. She uses that to tell a caller whether there is a wait and roughly how long. She never makes up a wait time: if there isn't enough information, she says so.

### Can a caller ask whether a specific provider is available?
Yes. Autumn can say whether that provider is working today, whether they are free or with a client right now, and roughly when they will be free.

### What does Autumn do when the salon is closed?
She tells the caller the salon is closed and acts as your after-hours answering service: booking, rescheduling, cancelling and answering questions. She does not give live wait times after hours, and she never implies anyone is at the salon.

### Does Autumn need training before she can take calls?
No. From the moment you enable her, Autumn already knows your services, staff members, schedule, business hours, and pricing — pulled directly from your Certxa account. Setup takes minutes.

### What happens if my credit balance runs out?
Autumn will stop taking new calls until the balance is topped up. We'll notify you well in advance and the optional auto top-up feature means you'll rarely run dry.

### Can callers tell they're speaking to an AI?
Autumn is designed to sound warm, natural, and professional. Many callers don't realise she isn't your front-desk team. If a caller specifically asks whether they're speaking to an AI, Autumn will answer honestly.

### Does Autumn work for multi-location businesses?
Yes. Autumn can be enabled independently per location, each with its own credit balance and configuration — ideal for salon groups and franchise owners.

## Transparent processing rates. No hidden fees.
Certxa Payments is powered by Stripe Connect. One flat rate — no monthly fee, no surprises.
Standard rate
All merchants
2.7% + 10¢ per dip and tap
No monthly fee
Keyed-in transactions: 3.5% + 15¢. Rates apply to all Certxa hardware via Stripe Connect.

## Hardware FAQ.

### What hardware does Certxa offer?
Certxa offers three main devices — Certxa Station (the full front desk terminal), Certxa Kiosk (the self check-in and customer-facing screen), and the Wireless Card Reader (powered by Stripe). Accessories include a customer facing screen, IP thermal receipt printer, cash drawer, and barcode scanner.

### Is the card reader really free?
Yes. The Wireless Card Reader is included free with every Professional plan. No minimum processing volume required — just sign up for Professional and it ships with your account.

### Is the hardware difficult to set up?
No. All Certxa hardware is plug-and-play. Connect it to your Certxa account and you're ready to go — most salons are up and running the same day their hardware arrives.

### What payment types are accepted?
All Certxa hardware supports chip (EMV), contactless tap-to-pay (NFC), and major digital wallets including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay. Swipe and keyed-in transactions are also supported.

### Does the hardware work if the internet goes down?
Yes. Certxa Station includes offline mode — tickets are saved locally and synced automatically when your connection is restored. No lost sales, no interruptions.

## Frequently asked questions
How much does Certxa cost?
The Solo plan, for one independent professional, is free with no credit card needed. Professional is $22 a month and Elite is $49 a month, or $18 and $39 a month when billed annually.
Is there a free trial?
Yes. Professional and Elite start with a 60-day free trial. A credit card is required to start a paid plan, but you are not charged until the trial ends. Solo is free and needs no trial.
Can I change plans later?
Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time. There are no long-term contracts.
What does card processing cost?
Payments run through Stripe. In-person card payments are 2.7% + $0.05 and online payments are 2.9% + $0.30, which is Stripe's rate, plus a $0.60 Certxa fee per card transaction.
Is the Autumn AI receptionist included?
Yes. Every plan includes Autumn: 20 calls a month on Solo, 50 on Professional and 100 on Elite. Additional calls are $0.50 each. There is a one-time $15 activation fee for your dedicated phone number, and included calls start once your paid plan begins.
What types of businesses does Certxa support?
Certxa is built for nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, massage studios, hair removal studios, and braid and weave salons.

## Questions about switching
Is the data transfer really free? Yes, completely. We include free data migration for every new Certxa account. No setup fees, no migration charges — ever. How long does the transfer take? Most transfers complete within 24 hours. Larger accounts with 10,000+ clients may take up to 48 hours. We'll email you the moment it's done. Will my clients lose their booking history? No. We transfer complete appointment history including service details, pricing, staff notes, and timestamps. What if my current software doesn't have an export feature? We can work with any CSV, Excel, or spreadsheet file. If you're stuck, our support team will help you extract the data directly. Do you detect duplicates? Yes — our import engine automatically flags duplicate clients based on phone number, email, name, and date of birth similarity, so you never end up with messy double records. What happens to my data if I cancel? You own your data completely. You can export everything in CSV, XLSX, or JSON format at any time, with one click. Can I try Certxa before committing to the transfer? Absolutely. Start your 60-day free trial first, explore the platform, and then request the transfer whenever you're ready. Is my data safe during transfer? All transfers use end-to-end encryption. Your data is never shared with third parties and is stored securely in compliance with GDPR. Free Transfer

## Certxa Changelog — Latest Updates & New Features
Source: https://certxa.com/changelog

Changelog

# What's new in Certxa.
What we've released, newest first.
2026.10.12 October 12, 2026 New Improved Fixed New
A ticket can now hold more than one service. One technician takes the whole visit when someone in the turn line can do every service; otherwise each service goes to the next technician who can.
New
Autumn, the AI receptionist, is now included in every plan: 20 calls a month on Solo, 50 on Professional and 100 on Elite.
New
Salons that use their own card terminal can set the CARD button to Own Provider, so the POS records the card payment without charging it.
Improved
Checkout asks the client for a tip once, as soon as staff press Pay / Checkout, and keeps it for the rest of the sale.
Improved
The POS keeps numbering tickets and running its timers when the internet is down.
Fixed
Paid tickets that were created while offline no longer stay in the queue.
2026.10.10 October 10, 2026 Improved Fixed Improved
Autumn sees the salon as it is right now: who is working, who is free and how many clients are waiting, so callers get a real wait time.
Fixed
New Google reviews are checked every 30 minutes and answered automatically; a check that was being skipped is fixed.
2026.10.09 October 9, 2026 New Improved New
The POS works offline: check-ins, tickets, assignments and cash sales are saved on the tablet and sent when the connection returns.
New
Smart Check-In: the kiosk recognises returning clients and suggests the service they are due for.
New
The Solo plan is now free.
New
Salons can set their own tip percentages for the customer tip screen and checkout.
New
Day Close reports: look up the close-out report for any day.
Improved
A new look for the nail salon kiosk, with a guide that helps clients choose a nail shape and length.
2026.10.05 October 5, 2026 New Improved New
Dollar-Based Turns: a second way to run the turn rotation, where a ticket earns turns by its service amount.
Improved
Only walk-in services count toward the turn rotation; tips, retail and advance bookings do not.
New
Managers can arrange the POS key grid: which categories and services appear on which key.
2026.09.23 September 23, 2026 Improved New Fixed Improved
Redesigned printed receipts, with a salon copy and a customer copy, and receipts sent by text as a link.
New
Gift cards can be sold, looked up and redeemed at checkout.
New
Group Pay: pay several tickets together in one checkout.
Fixed
Receipt printing no longer crashes or freezes the tablet app on network and Bluetooth printers.
2026.09.20 September 20, 2026 New Improved New
Nail POS: a front desk screen for nail salons with walk-in tickets, turn-based assignment, a live board of who is waiting and in service, and checkout.
New
Techs board: a card for each technician showing whether they are free, in service or on break, with a live timer.
Improved
A setting for time between appointments (0, 5, 10 or 15 minutes), applied everywhere bookings are made.

## Certxa Product Roadmap — Upcoming Salon Software Features
Source: https://certxa.com/roadmap

Product roadmap

# Where Certxa is headed.
What we're building now, what comes next, and what has shipped.
In progress 3

### Tablets that keep working together offline
The POS and the customer screen stay connected over the salon's own Wi-Fi when the internet is down. In testing.

### Card payments during an outage
Take chip and contactless cards on the card reader with no internet; the payments are sent when the connection returns.

### Order hardware online
Buy Certxa hardware from the Hardware page, with shipping worked out for your address.
Planned 3

### Deposits and prepayments
Require a deposit or full prepayment when a client books online.

### Kiosk check-in with no internet
Clients keep checking themselves in at the kiosk during an outage.

### Instagram gallery sync
Show your Instagram photos on your salon website automatically.
Shipped 7

### Autumn AI receptionist
Answers the salon's phone, books appointments and gives callers a real wait time.

### Self check-in kiosk
Clients check themselves in on a tablet and join the queue.

### Turn rotation
Walk-ins are given to the next technician in line, by counted or dollar-based turns.

### Loyalty points and rewards
Clients earn points per dollar and redeem them for money off.

### Gift cards
Sell and redeem gift cards at checkout.

### Google review requests and replies
Clients are asked for a review after their visit, and new Google reviews are answered automatically.

### Offline mode for the POS
Check-ins, tickets and cash sales keep working without internet and sync afterwards.

## Certxa vs GlossGenius — Salon Software Comparison (2026)
Source: https://certxa.com/compare/certxa-vs-glossgenius

# More than booking. A complete business platform.
Certxa vs GlossGenius

# More than booking. A complete business platform.
GlossGenius is a solid booking tool for solo stylists. Certxa is built for the full operation — walk-ins, waitlist, team payroll, revenue intelligence, and an AI receptionist — all in one platform, with no long-term contracts.
Try Certxa free for 60 days See pricing
Free Solo plan · 60-day trial on team plans
Certxa
Certxa is built for multi-staff beauty businesses — nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, and massage studios. It covers the full operation: online booking, walk-in management, waitlist, self check-in kiosk, POS, team payroll, loyalty programs, revenue intelligence, and an AI receptionist.
G
GlossGenius
GlossGenius is a booking and payment platform popular with independent stylists and solo beauty professionals. It offers a clean booking experience and card processing, but is primarily designed for single-provider businesses.

## Where it matters most
The features that matter most to nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, and massage studios.

### Waitlist management
Certxa
Live digital waitlist captures every walk-in. When a slot opens, the next client is auto-texted and given a one-tap confirmation window.
GlossGenius
No built-in waitlist management for walk-in businesses.

### Revenue intelligence
Certxa
Automatically detects client drift, identifies dead time slots, scores no-show risk, and sends re-engagement texts — without any manual work.
GlossGenius
Basic reporting. No proactive revenue recovery or client drift detection.

### Self check-in kiosk
Certxa
Tablet kiosk lets clients check in, pick their service, and join the queue — in English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean.
GlossGenius
No self check-in kiosk for walk-in or appointment-based businesses.

### AI receptionist
Certxa
Autumn AI answers calls 24/7, books appointments, and handles rescheduling against your real-time availability.
GlossGenius
No AI receptionist or automated phone answering.

### Team payroll
Certxa
Commission rates per staff member, tips tracked separately, pay periods, earnings statements, and printed paychecks — all built in.
GlossGenius
Limited to solo providers. No built-in team payroll or commission tracking for multi-staff businesses.

### Turn rotation
Certxa
Automatic walk-in assignment to staff based on rules you set. Live turn board shows who is next, busy, or on break.
GlossGenius
No turn rotation system for walk-in queue management.

## About Certxa — Salon Software Built by Salon People
Source: https://certxa.com/about

Our story

# Founded by a salon owner, for salon owners.
Certxa was founded in Phoenix, Arizona in 2026 by Thanh Lam, a Vietnamese nail salon owner who got tired of watching salon owners get pushed into long-term contracts for software that never quite fit how salons actually work.

## Why we built Certxa
Thanh started Certxa after watching Vietnamese-owned nail salons — a community he's part of — get locked into long-term contracts with existing salon software providers just to get basic booking and check-in tools. He wanted to build a real alternative: no long-term lock-in, and software built by someone who has actually run a salon, not just sold to one. That's still the idea behind Certxa today: salon software should help you run your business — not overwhelm it, and not trap you in a contract you can't get out of. Many platforms require multiple subscriptions, disconnected tools, and complicated workflows just to manage everyday tasks. Certxa brings online booking, point of sale, payments, client management, team management, payroll, and AI-powered tools together in one platform — so you spend less time switching between systems and more time focusing on your clients. Certxa is built for nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, massage studios, hair removal studios, and braid and weave salons.

### Salons first
Every feature we build starts with a real problem a salon owner told us about. We don't ship for the sake of shipping.

### Radical simplicity
If a feature takes more than 30 seconds to learn, we redesign it. Complexity is a bug, not a feature.

### Transparent by default
No hidden fees, no surprise rate changes, no lock-in contracts. We earn your business every month.

### Always improving
We ship updates every week. Our changelog is public and our roadmap is open — you always know what's coming.

## Meet the team
T
Thanh Lam
Founder
A Vietnamese nail salon owner from Phoenix, Arizona. Thanh built Certxa after experiencing firsthand how existing salon software locked owners into long-term contracts for tools that didn't fit how salons actually operate.
T
Toby Benjamin
SaaS Developer
Toby brings the technical depth to turn Thanh's vision into a reliable, scalable platform. He focuses on building software that's fast, stable, and genuinely easy to use.

Book a 20-minute demo and we'll show you exactly how Certxa fits your business.

## Privacy Policy | Certxa
Source: https://certxa.com/privacy

Skip to main content

# Privacy Policy
Effective: February 1, 2026 · Last updated: September 12, 2026
Plain-English summary: Certxa collects only what we need to run our service. We never sell your personal data or use it for advertising. We never share it with third parties except to operate the platform (payments, messaging, AI). If you connect Google Business Profile, your Google data is used solely to manage your listing inside Certxa. You can request deletion or export of your data at any time.
Table of Contents
- Who We Are
- Data We Collect
- Google Business Profile API Data
- How We Use Your Data
- Data Sharing & Third Parties
- Data Retention
- Security
- Your Rights (GDPR & CCPA)
- California Privacy Rights (CCPA/CPRA)
- Cookies & Tracking
- Children's Privacy
- Changes to This Policy
- SMS Communications
- Contact Us

## 1. Who We Are
Certxa ("Certxa", "we", "us", "our") operates the SalonOS salon management platform available at certxa.com and its sub-domains. We provide appointment scheduling, point-of-sale, client management, AI receptionist, loyalty programs, staff management, payroll, multi-location tools, and Google Business Profile review management to beauty and wellness professionals.
This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and share information when you use our platform. By using Certxa, you agree to the practices described in this Policy.
For privacy-related questions, contact us at privacy@certxa.com.

## 2. Data We Collect

### Account & Profile Data
- Name, email address, phone number
- Business name, address, type (nail salon, nail studio, etc.), and operating hours
- Password (stored as a salted bcrypt hash — never in plain text)
- Profile photo and business logo (if uploaded)
- Billing and subscription information (processed by Stripe — we do not store raw card numbers or CVVs)
- Government-issued ID or tax information if required for Stripe Connect payouts

### Business Operational Data
- Services offered, pricing, and service duration settings
- Staff profiles, schedules, roles, and commission structures
- Contractor and booth-renter agreements and payout records
- Appointment records, cancellations, and no-show history
- Point-of-sale transaction records, cash drawer logs, and end-of-day reports
- Inventory and retail product records
- Multi-location configurations and location-specific settings
- Subscription tier and billing cycle information

### Client Data You Provide
When you add clients to Certxa, you provide us with their names, phone numbers, email addresses, visit history, appointment notes, and optional loyalty point balances. You represent that you have obtained any necessary consent from your clients to store their data and contact them through our platform. Your clients' data belongs to you — we process it on your behalf to operate the platform.

### AI Receptionist & Communication Data
- Inbound and outbound call logs, including AI-generated call transcripts
- SMS message logs sent or received through the platform (via Twilio)
- Email communication logs for appointment reminders and marketing
- Audio recordings of calls where legally permitted and with appropriate disclosures

### Usage & Technical Data
- Log data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, and timestamps
- Device information: screen resolution, operating system, and browser version
- Session tokens (stored in encrypted, server-side sessions via secure HttpOnly cookies)
- In-app feature usage and navigation patterns (aggregated and anonymised)

### Analytics & Check-In Kiosk Data
- Walk-in queue events, kiosk check-in timestamps, and service selection logs
- Revenue reporting metrics and trend data tied to your business account
- Booking source attribution (online, kiosk, staff-created, AI-booked)

## 3. Google Business Profile API Data

### Google API Services User Data Policy
Certxa's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including all applicable Limited Use requirements. We do not use Google user data to serve advertising, and we do not allow humans to read Google user data except as required to provide the service, respond to your support requests, or comply with applicable law.

### What Google Data We Access
Certxa allows business owners to connect their Google Business Profile account using Google's secure OAuth 2.0 authorization process. This connection is entirely optional and requires explicit user consent before any Google data is accessed. When a business owner connects their Google Business Profile, Certxa may access:
- Business location and profile information (name, address, operating hours, categories)
- Public Google reviews associated with the business listing
- Business website URL field (only when you choose to update or synchronize your Certxa-hosted website URL)
- Business photos already published to the listing (read-only, for dashboard display)

### How We Use This Google Data
We use Google Business Profile data solely to provide functionality within the Certxa platform, specifically to:
- Display your Google reviews inside your Certxa dashboard and on your Certxa-hosted website
- Help you manage and respond to reviews from within Certxa
- Allow you to update your Google Business Profile website URL to point to your Certxa booking page
- Synchronize business profile information for display and verification within the Certxa dashboard

### What We Do Not Do With Google Data
- We do not access any Google account without explicit, active user authorization
- We do not access personal Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, or any unrelated Google services
- We do not sell, rent, or share Google Business Profile data with any third party
- We do not modify your Google Business Profile data without a direct action or approval from you
- We do not use Google data to train AI models or for any purpose beyond operating Certxa for you
- We do not allow humans to read your Google data except to provide the service, resolve a support issue you raised, or comply with law

### Data Storage & Disconnection
Certxa may temporarily cache Google Business Profile data (e.g., review lists) to reduce API calls and improve performance. You may disconnect your Google account at any time from your Certxa dashboard settings, which immediately revokes our access token and stops further data retrieval. Upon disconnection or account deletion, cached Google data is deleted within 30 days unless a shorter period is required by applicable law.

### AI Receptionist & Google Data Separation
Certxa's AI Receptionist feature is completely separate from the Google Business Profile integration. The AI Receptionist does not access, read, or use any data obtained from Google APIs. Call transcripts, booking context, and AI responses are processed using only data in your Certxa account (client records, services, and availability settings). Google Business Profile data and AI Receptionist data are stored separately and never combined for any purpose whatsoever.

## 4. How We Use Your Data

### To Provide the Service
We use your data to operate Certxa — running your appointment calendar, online booking page, POS, client management, staff scheduling, payroll calculations, and loyalty program.

### To Process Payments
We pass payment information to Stripe to process charges, issue refunds, and manage subscriptions. For businesses using Stripe Connect, we facilitate payouts to staff and contractors. We do not store full card numbers or CVV codes at any point.

### To Send Communications
We use your data to send appointment reminders, booking confirmations, and marketing messages to your clients via SMS (Twilio) and email (Mailgun), on your behalf and at your direction. We also send you platform notifications, billing receipts, and service updates.

### To Power the AI Receptionist
Call transcripts and booking context are used by our AI systems to answer calls, book appointments, and identify returning clients. These calls are processed using AI services (including OpenAI). Transcripts are stored in your account and may be reviewed by you at any time.

### To Sync Google Business Profile
If connected, we use the Google API to display and help you manage your business listing, reviews, and website URL — as described in Section 3.

### To Improve the Platform
We analyze aggregated, anonymised usage patterns to improve product features, fix bugs, and prioritize development. We never share individual-level data externally for this purpose.

### To Prevent Fraud & Comply With Law
We use data to detect abuse, enforce our Terms of Service, and comply with applicable legal obligations including tax reporting and financial record-keeping.

### Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA) or UK, our lawful basis for processing your personal data is:
- Contract performance — processing necessary to provide the service you signed up for
- Legitimate interests — fraud prevention, security monitoring, product improvement, and analytics
- Legal obligation — financial record-keeping, tax compliance
- Consent — marketing communications and Google API access (withdrawable at any time)

## 5. Data Sharing & Third Parties
We do not sell your personal data. We do not share your data with third parties for their own marketing or advertising purposes. We share data only with the following service providers, strictly to operate Certxa:
| Provider | Purpose | Data Shared
| Stripe | Payment processing & payouts | Billing info, identity data for Stripe Connect
| Twilio | SMS and voice call delivery | Phone numbers, message content
| Mailgun | Transactional & marketing email | Email addresses, message content
| OpenAI | AI Receptionist — call handling & booking automation | Call transcripts, appointment context (no raw PII beyond what's needed for the call)
| Google APIs | Business Profile sync, OAuth login | Only data you explicitly authorize via OAuth
| Cloud hosting | Infrastructure & storage | All platform data (stored encrypted at rest)
| Analytics | Aggregated usage analysis | Anonymised, aggregated usage events only
We require all service providers to maintain appropriate data protection standards and contractual data processing agreements where required by law. We do not permit them to use your data for their own independent purposes.
We may also disclose data when required by applicable law, valid legal process (such as a court order or subpoena), or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Certxa, our users, or the public.

## 6. Data Retention
- Active accounts: Data is retained for the full duration of your active subscription.
- Cancelled or expired accounts: We retain your data for 90 days after cancellation to allow account recovery, then delete or anonymise it.
- Client data: Deleted with your account unless you export it first. You may export all client records from your dashboard at any time.
- Google API data: OAuth tokens are revoked immediately on disconnection. Synced review records are deleted within 30 days of account deletion or disconnection.
- Billing & financial records: Retained for 7 years as required by applicable financial and tax regulations.
- Call transcripts & AI logs: Retained for 90 days, then purged unless you choose to archive them.
- Server logs: Retained for 30 days for security monitoring, then purged.

## 7. Security
We take data security seriously and maintain the following controls:
- All data is transmitted over HTTPS/TLS — plain HTTP is redirected and not accepted
- Passwords are stored using bcrypt with per-user random salts — we never store or log plain-text passwords
- OAuth tokens and API keys are stored encrypted at rest using server-side encryption
- Session tokens use HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Lax cookie attributes to prevent XSS and CSRF attacks
- Role-based access control (RBAC) restricts what staff accounts can view or modify
- Database servers are not publicly accessible — only accessible from application servers within a private network
- API credentials and service secrets are stored in secure environment secret vaults, never committed to source code
- Audit logging records sensitive admin actions with timestamps and actor IDs
- We conduct periodic security reviews and dependency vulnerability audits
If you believe you have discovered a security vulnerability in Certxa, please report it responsibly to security@certxa.com. We investigate all credible reports promptly.

## 8. Your Rights (GDPR & Global)
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
- Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you or your business account
- Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
- Deletion ("Right to be forgotten"): Request deletion of your account and associated personal data
- Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (e.g., CSV export)
- Objection: Object to processing for direct marketing or based on legitimate interests
- Restriction: Request that we restrict processing in specific circumstances (e.g., while a dispute is being resolved)
- Withdraw consent: Where processing is based on consent (e.g., marketing emails, Google connection), you may withdraw at any time without affecting lawfulness of prior processing
To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@certxa.com from the email address on your account. We will respond within 30 days. For Google-specific data access, you may also manage or revoke our permissions directly via Google Account Settings.

## 9. California Privacy Rights (CCPA / CPRA)
CCPA / CPRA
If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA):
- Right to Know: Request disclosure of the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you in the past 12 months
- Right to Delete: Request deletion of your personal information, subject to certain exceptions
- Right to Correct: Request correction of inaccurate personal information
- Right to Opt-Out of Sale or Sharing: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. You do not need to opt out, but you may contact us to confirm.
- Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information: You may request that we limit our use of sensitive personal information to what is necessary to provide the service
- Right to Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of these rights
Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information: Certxa does not sell personal information. We do not share personal information with third parties for cross-context behavioral advertising.
To submit a California privacy request, email privacy@certxa.com with the subject line "California Privacy Request." We will respond within 45 days as required by law.

## 10. Cookies & Tracking
We use the following types of cookies and similar technologies:
- Strictly necessary: Session authentication cookie — required for you to stay logged in. Cannot be disabled without breaking login.
- Functional: Remembers your UI preferences such as timezone and display settings. These expire after your session or within 30 days.
- Analytics: Aggregated, anonymised page-view analytics to help us understand how the platform is used. No cross-site tracking, no fingerprinting, no individual user profiles shared externally.
We do not use third-party advertising cookies or tracking pixels. We do not engage in cross-site behavioral advertising. You can manage or clear cookies through your browser settings at any time; disabling the session cookie will log you out.

## 11. Children's Privacy
Certxa is a business platform intended for users aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. If we become aware that a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, we will delete it promptly. If you believe a child's data has been submitted, contact privacy@certxa.com.

## 12. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. When we make material changes, we will notify you by email (to the address on your account) at least 14 days before the effective date, and post the updated policy here with a revised "Last updated" date. Continued use of Certxa after the effective date of the updated policy constitutes acceptance. If you do not accept the changes, you may close your account and request deletion of your data.

## 13. SMS Communications
Certxa LLC provides appointment management and customer communication services for salons using the Certxa platform. If you provide your phone number and consent to receive text messages, Certxa LLC may send SMS messages on behalf of the salon you are interacting with.

### SMS messages may include:
- Appointment confirmations
- Appointment reminders
- Appointment cancellations
- Appointment rescheduling updates
- Waitlist availability notifications
- Other appointment-related communications
By providing your phone number and opting in to receive SMS messages, you consent to receive automated text messages from Certxa LLC on behalf of the selected salon. Message frequency varies depending on your appointments and interactions with the salon. Message and data rates may apply.
You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any message. After you send STOP, you may receive a confirmation message that your request has been processed. You may also reply HELP for assistance.
Your SMS consent is separate from any other communication preferences, and consent to receive text messages is not a condition of purchasing any products or services.
Certxa LLC does not sell, rent, or share your phone number or SMS consent information with third parties for their own marketing purposes. Phone numbers collected for SMS communications are used only for providing appointment-related notifications and supporting the services requested by you or the salon you are booking with.
If you have questions about SMS communications, please contact Certxa LLC through the support channels provided on our website.

## 14. Contact Us
For privacy-related questions, data requests, or to exercise your rights:
- Privacy inquiries: privacy@certxa.com
- General support: support@certxa.com
- Security reports: security@certxa.com
- Website: certxa.com/contact

## Google Data Policy | How Certxa Uses Google Business Profile Data

# How Certxa Uses Your Google Business Profile
Certxa helps nail studio and salon owners manage their bookings and Google Business Profile from one dashboard. This page explains exactly what Google data we access, why, and how to revoke access at any time.
What does Certxa do?
Certxa helps service businesses manage bookings and their Google Business Profile listing from one dashboard.
Why does Certxa need Google data?
To sync your business listing info and public reviews so you can manage and respond to them inside Certxa — without leaving the dashboard.
What happens to your data?
Your Google Business Profile data is used only to operate the Certxa integration for you. It is never sold, shared with third parties, or used for advertising.
Can you disconnect instantly?
Yes. Disconnect from your Certxa dashboard in one click, or revoke directly from Google Account Settings. Access is revoked immediately.

## 1. Who Certxa Is — and Who We Are Not

### 🔴 Certxa is NOT Google
Certxa is an independent, third-party SaaS platform for salons and service businesses. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or a product of Google LLC. "Google" and "Google Business Profile" are trademarks of Google LLC. Google is not responsible for Certxa's actions, data practices, or this policy.
Certxa is a multi-feature salon management platform providing appointment scheduling, POS, client management, staff scheduling, and Google Business Profile integration — all in one place, built specifically for beauty and wellness professionals.
We connect to Google Business Profile using Google's official OAuth 2.0 authorization. The connection is optional, initiated entirely by you, and can be revoked at any time.

## 2. What Google Data We Access
Certxa requests the business.manage scope — Google's standard scope for managing a business listing — and uses it only to:
| Data | Purpose | Accessed?
| Business name, address, hours | Display connected listing info in your Certxa dashboard | Yes — read
| Public Google reviews | Sync reviews so you can view and respond to them inside Certxa | Yes — read
| Business website URL field | Update to point to your Certxa booking page — only when you initiate this | Yes — write (on request)
| Gmail / email | — | Never accessed
| Google Drive / Docs / Sheets | — | Never accessed
| Google Calendar | — | Never accessed
| Google Contacts | — | Never accessed
| Personal Google account data | — | Never accessed

## 3. How We Use Google Data

### ✅ What Certxa DOES with Google data
- Displays your business listing details inside your Certxa dashboard
- Shows your Google reviews so you can read and respond to them in one place
- Syncs review data automatically every 6 hours to keep your dashboard current
- Updates your Google Business Profile website URL to your Certxa booking page (only when you click "update")

### ❌ What Certxa does NOT do with Google data
- Does NOT sell, rent, or share your Google data with any third party
- Does NOT use Google data for advertising, marketing analytics, or insights
- Does NOT use Google data to train AI models
- Does NOT access your Google account without your explicit authorization
- Does NOT make changes to your Google Business Profile without your direct action
- Does NOT allow any human to read your Google data except to provide the service, resolve a support request you raised, or comply with law
- Does NOT combine Google Business Profile data with AI Receptionist call data (these are entirely separate systems)

### AI Receptionist — Entirely Separate
Certxa's AI Receptionist (automated phone booking) is a completely separate feature. It does not read, access, or use any data obtained from Google APIs. The AI Receptionist uses only your Certxa account data — client records, services, and availability — to answer calls and book appointments. These two features share no data whatsoever.

## 4. How We Store Google Data
- OAuth tokens are stored encrypted at rest on our servers. They are used only to make authorized API calls on your behalf.
- Review data is cached to reduce repeated API calls and improve dashboard performance. Cached data is refreshed automatically every 6 hours.
- On disconnection, your OAuth token is revoked immediately and all cached Google data is deleted within 30 days.
- On account deletion, all associated Google data (tokens and cached reviews) is deleted within 30 days.
- We never store data beyond what is necessary to operate the integration for you.

## 5. How to Revoke Access — Instantly
🔌

### Disconnect in one click
You can revoke Certxa's access to your Google Business Profile at any time. Disconnecting immediately revokes our OAuth token and stops all further data retrieval. You can also revoke directly from your Google Account settings — both methods work instantly.
Disconnect from Certxa Dashboard Revoke via Google Account →

### What happens after you disconnect
- Certxa's OAuth token is revoked immediately — we can no longer access your Google account
- Your Certxa account and all non-Google data remain intact
- Cached Google review data is deleted from our servers within 30 days
- You can reconnect at any time from your Certxa dashboard if you change your mind

## 6. Compliance
Certxa's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including all applicable Limited Use requirements. Specifically:
- We only use Google data to provide and improve the Google Business Profile integration feature for you
- We do not use Google data to serve advertising
- We do not allow humans to read Google data except to provide the service, respond to your support requests, or comply with applicable law
- We do not transfer Google data to third parties except as necessary to operate the integration (e.g., secure hosting infrastructure)
Our full data handling practices for Google APIs are documented in our Privacy Policy, Section 3.

## 7. Contact Us
Questions about how Certxa uses your Google data?
- Privacy: privacy@certxa.com
- Support: support@certxa.com
- Full Privacy Policy: certxa.com/privacy
- Terms of Service: certxa.com/terms

# Terms of Service
Last updated: June 27, 2026
By creating an account or using Certxa, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the platform. These Terms constitute a binding agreement between you (the business or individual account holder) and Certxa.

## 1. Description of Service
Certxa provides a multi-tenant SaaS platform ("the Service") built for nail salons, nail studios, and independent nail technicians. The Service includes:
- Online appointment scheduling and client-facing booking pages
- Point-of-sale (POS) system including product sales, tipping, and cash drawer management
- Client CRM, visit history, notes, and loyalty point management
- Staff scheduling, role management, and commission/payroll tracking
- Contractor and booth-renter agreement and payout management
- Walk-in kiosk and waitlist system
- AI Receptionist for automated phone call handling and booking
- SMS and email marketing and reminder automation
- Multi-location management tools
- Revenue analytics and reporting
- Custom website builder and Certxa-hosted booking websites
- Google Business Profile integration for review management and website sync
- Subscription billing management via Stripe
We reserve the right to modify, add, or discontinue features at any time. Material changes will be communicated with reasonable notice.

## 2. Accounts & Eligibility

### Eligibility
You must be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering into a binding contract to create a Certxa account. By using the Service, you represent that you meet these requirements.

### Account Responsibility
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. You agree to notify us immediately at support@certxa.com if you become aware of any unauthorized access to your account. Certxa is not liable for any loss or damage resulting from unauthorized access caused by your failure to safeguard your credentials.

### Business Representation
Each Certxa account must represent a real, lawfully operating business entity or an independent professional. You may not create accounts to impersonate others, misrepresent your business, or engage in fraudulent activity. If you create an account on behalf of a company or organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that entity to these Terms.

### Account Accuracy
You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and to keep it updated. Inaccurate or misleading information may result in suspension or termination of your account.

## 3. Subscription & Billing

### Plans & Fees
Certxa offers paid subscription plans billed monthly or annually. Current plan details and pricing are displayed at certxa.com/pricing. Prices may change with at least 30 days' advance notice to active subscribers.

### Trial Period
New accounts may be eligible for a free trial period as displayed at sign-up. No payment information is required during the trial unless otherwise stated. At the end of the trial, you will be prompted to select a paid plan to continue using the Service.

### Billing & Auto-Renewal
Subscriptions are billed automatically at the start of each billing period (monthly or annual) using the payment method on file, processed securely through Stripe. By subscribing, you authorize Certxa to charge your payment method on a recurring basis until you cancel.

### Refund Policy
All subscription fees are non-refundable except where required by applicable law. If you cancel your subscription, you will retain access to the Service through the end of your current billing period. We do not provide prorated refunds for partial months unless required by law. In exceptional circumstances (e.g., significant service outages attributable to Certxa), we may issue account credits at our sole discretion.

### Late Payments & Failed Charges
If a payment fails, we will attempt to retry the charge. Continued failure to pay may result in suspension of your account. You remain responsible for any amounts owed even after suspension or termination.

### Cancellation
You may cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings or by contacting support@certxa.com. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. We do not charge cancellation fees.

## 4. Data Ownership

### Your Data Belongs to You
All business data, client data, appointment records, and content you create or upload within Certxa remains your property. You grant Certxa a limited, non-exclusive license to process and store your data solely to provide the Service.

### Client Data
You are the data controller for client information you enter into Certxa. Certxa acts as a data processor on your behalf. You are responsible for ensuring you have the necessary consents, permissions, and legal bases to collect your clients' personal information and use our platform to contact them.

### Data Export
You may export your data (clients, appointments, financial records) at any time from your dashboard. We will provide your data in standard formats (CSV, JSON). After account deletion, data may be irretrievable, so we recommend exporting before cancellation.

### Account Deletion & Data Retention
You may permanently delete your account at any time directly from your Account Settings page (Account → Danger Zone → Delete my account). Deletion requires your current password and confirmation. Once deleted:
- Your access to the platform is removed immediately
- Your active subscription is cancelled at end of the current billing period
- Business data, client records, and appointments are deactivated and no longer accessible to you
- Financial records (appointments, payroll, invoices, payments) are retained until February 1st of the following calendar year for tax and legal compliance purposes, after which they are permanently purged
- Staff accounts linked to your business also lose access upon account deletion
If you signed up with Google, contact support@certxa.com to initiate deletion (password confirmation is not possible for Google-linked accounts via the in-app flow). We will process your request within 5 business days.

### No Claim on Your Data
Certxa will never sell your business data or client data to third parties, use it to train AI models without your consent, or use it for purposes beyond operating the Service for you.

## 5. AI Receptionist
Important: The AI Receptionist is an automated tool. It may make mistakes. You are responsible for verifying all bookings, cancellations, and reschedules created by the AI before treating them as confirmed.

### How It Works
Certxa's AI Receptionist answers inbound phone calls on your behalf, uses AI voice and language models (including OpenAI) to understand caller requests, and can book, cancel, or reschedule appointments based on your live availability settings.

### Accuracy Disclaimer
The AI Receptionist may mishear callers, misinterpret requests, or generate incorrect responses. AI-created booking actions are not legally binding commitments from Certxa. You remain solely responsible for verifying and honoring (or correcting) appointments created by the AI.

### Not Legal or Medical Advice
The AI Receptionist does not provide legal, medical, financial, or professional advice of any kind. Any information it conveys is for appointment coordination purposes only.

### Google Data Separation
The AI Receptionist does not access, read, or use any data from Google Business Profile or any other Google API. Call handling, appointment booking, and all AI Receptionist responses are based solely on data stored in your Certxa account (client records, services, and availability). The AI Receptionist and Google Business Profile integration are completely separate systems that do not share data.

### Call Recording & Transcripts
Calls handled by the AI Receptionist may be transcribed and stored in your account for your review. If your jurisdiction requires disclosure to callers that a call is being recorded or handled by AI, you are responsible for ensuring that disclosure is made (e.g., via a greeting message you configure in the platform).

### Caller Recognition
The AI Receptionist may attempt to identify returning callers based on phone number matching to existing client records. This feature uses only data stored in your Certxa account.

## 6. Payments & Stripe Connect

### Payment Processing
Certxa uses Stripe to process all payments made through the platform, including client charges, subscription billing, and staff/contractor payouts via Stripe Connect. By using payment features, you agree to Stripe's Connected Account Agreement and Stripe's Privacy Policy.

### Certxa Is Not a Bank
Certxa is a software platform, not a bank, money services business, or payment processor. All payment processing, fund holding, and payout operations are performed by Stripe. Certxa does not hold client funds on your behalf.

### Platform Fees

# Vietnamese nail salon POS system
A modern Vietnamese nail salon POS system helps you manage appointments, walk-ins, technicians, customers, services, commissions, and payments all in one place. Certxa gives busy nail salons the simple, fast tools they need to keep the salon running smoothly.
T Thanh Lam October 4, 2026
Vietnamese Nail Salon POS System: The Complete Guide for Modern Nail Salons
Running a Vietnamese nail salon is different from running a typical retail business. Your salon may have multiple nail technicians, walk-in customers, appointments, different service combinations, technician commissions, and a busy front desk where every second matters.
That is why choosing the right Vietnamese nail salon POS system can make a major difference.
A modern nail salon POS system should do much more than process credit cards. It should help you manage appointments, walk-ins, customers, technicians, services, payments, commissions, and daily salon operations from one simple system.

## What Is a Vietnamese Nail Salon POS System?
A Vietnamese nail salon POS system is point-of-sale software designed around the way nail salons actually operate.
Instead of forcing your salon to adapt to a generic restaurant or retail POS, a nail salon system should understand services such as:
Manicures
Pedicures
Acrylic nails
Gel-X
Dip powder
Nail art
Gel polish
Nail extensions
Waxing
Threading
Removals
Add-ons and upgrades
The best systems also connect the front desk, technicians, customers, appointments, and payments so your salon does not have to rely on multiple disconnected systems.

## Why Vietnamese Nail Salons Need Specialized POS Software
Many Vietnamese-owned nail salons have a high-volume business model. Customers may walk in without appointments, several technicians may be working simultaneously, and the front desk may need to keep track of who is available and which customer is waiting.
A generic POS system can process a payment, but that doesn't necessarily mean it understands your salon.
For example, a busy nail salon may need to know:
Who is waiting?
Which technician is available?
Who performs pedicures?
Which services does each technician perform?
How long has a customer been waiting?
What services were performed?
How much should the technician receive in commission?
Has the customer paid?
A nail salon POS should make these answers easy to see.

## Walk-Ins Should Be Just as Easy as Appointments
Walk-ins are a major part of many nail salons.
When four customers walk through the door at the same time, your staff shouldn't have to create complicated records just to put them in line.
A good nail salon POS should allow your receptionist to quickly:
Add the customer to the waitlist.
Select the services they want.
See which technicians are available.
Match the customer with an appropriate technician.
Start the service.
Complete the ticket.
Take payment.
Move to the next customer.
The goal is simple: less tapping, less searching, and less confusion.

## Manage Your Nail Technicians
Technician management is another important part of a salon POS.
Your system should let you keep track of your technicians and their working schedules while making it easy to see who is currently available.
For larger salons, technician qualifications can become especially important.
For example, one technician might perform manicures and pedicures, while another specializes in acrylic or Gel-X services.
Instead of showing every available technician for every customer, a smart POS can match the requested service with technicians who are qualified to perform it.
This can help keep the line moving while reducing unnecessary back-and-forth at the front desk.

## Make Checkout Fast
The checkout process should be one of the easiest parts of the customer's visit.
A nail technician should not have to spend several minutes searching through a complicated POS just to enter a completed service.
A modern system can make checkout much faster by showing the customer's ticket and allowing staff to quickly add or modify services.
For salons that frequently have customers paying at the front desk, this can make a noticeable difference during busy periods.

## Track Technician Commissions
Many nail salons pay technicians based on commission.
Your POS should make it easy to see what each technician earned from completed services.
Instead of manually calculating commissions at the end of the day, salon owners can use their POS data to help track:
Service sales
Technician sales
Commission amounts
Tips
Total tickets
Average ticket size
Daily and monthly performance
This gives the owner a much clearer picture of how the salon is performing.

## Keep Customer Information in One Place
A salon POS should also function as a customer management system.
Customer profiles can contain information such as:
Name
Phone number
Appointment history
Services received
Visit history
Notes
Spending history
This becomes particularly valuable for repeat customers.
When a customer returns, your staff can quickly find their profile instead of treating every visit like a brand-new transaction.

## Appointments and Online Booking
Today's customers expect to be able to book appointments online.
A modern Vietnamese nail salon POS can connect your online booking system with your salon's schedule.
Customers can select a service, choose an available time, and book without having to call the salon.
The salon can then manage those appointments alongside walk-ins from the same system.
That is important because your front desk should not have to manage one schedule for online appointments and another system for walk-in customers.

## Accept Credit Cards and Contactless Payments
Payments are obviously a major part of any POS system.
Modern nail salons should be able to accept:
Credit cards
Debit cards
Tap-to-pay
Mobile wallets
Contactless payments
A salon POS with integrated payment processing can also reduce the need for staff to manually enter transaction information.
The smoother the checkout process, the faster your salon can move customers through the front desk.

## Your POS Should Help You Run the Business
A POS system shouldn't just tell you how much money was collected today.
It should help you understand what is happening inside your salon.
For example, an owner may want to know:
How many customers came in today?
How much did the salon sell?
What was the average ticket?
Which services are most popular?
Which technicians generated the most sales?
How busy was the salon?
How many appointments were missed?
How many customers are currently waiting?
These are the kinds of questions a modern salon management system should make easy to answer.

## What Should You Look for in a Vietnamese Nail Salon POS?
When comparing systems, don't simply look at the price.
Look for a system that fits the way your salon actually operates.

### 1. Nail-specific services
The system should make it easy to build tickets around real nail salon services and add-ons.

### 2. Walk-in management
Your POS should handle customers who don't have appointments.

### 3. Online booking
Customers should be able to book appointments without calling.

### 4. Technician management
You should be able to manage schedules, availability, services, and commissions.

### 5. Customer management
Customer information and visit history should be easily accessible.

### 6. Integrated payments
Payments should be fast and simple for both staff and customers.

### 7. Easy-to-use hardware
A POS that looks impressive but takes ten taps to perform a simple transaction isn't necessarily a good POS.
For a busy nail salon, speed and simplicity matter.

## Don't Let Your POS Become Another Complicated System
Salon owners already have enough to manage.
The purpose of technology should be to make the business easier—not create another complicated job for the owner.
The best nail salon POS systems put the information you need directly in front of you.
Instead of searching through multiple screens, you should be able to quickly see what matters:
Who's here.
Who's waiting.
Who's working.
What's being performed.
Who's getting paid.
How much the salon made.
That's what a modern salon POS should accomplish.

## Certxa: Built for Nail Salons
Certxa is built specifically around the needs of modern nail salons.
Certxa combines salon management, POS, appointments, walk-ins, customer management, technician management, payments, and marketing tools into one platform.
Instead of stitching together several different systems, salon owners can manage their day from one place.
For a busy Vietnamese nail salon, the goal isn't to have more software.
The goal is to have a salon that runs more smoothly.
And your POS should help make that happen.

## Final Thoughts
Choosing a Vietnamese nail salon POS system is ultimately about finding technology that fits your business.
A good system should make your front desk faster, help your technicians stay organized, simplify payments, keep customer information accessible, and give the owner a clear view of the business.
If your current POS feels complicated, slow, or designed for a business that isn't a nail salon, it may be time to look at a system built specifically for the way nail salons operate.
Your salon is busy enough. Your POS shouldn't make it harder.

T Thanh Lam October 4, 2026
Salon Turn System & Walk-In Queue Software for Nail Salons
Managing walk-in customers can become one of the biggest challenges in a busy nail salon. When several customers arrive at once, the front desk needs to know who is waiting, what service they want, which technicians are available, and who should take the next customer.
Certxa's Salon Turn System is built specifically to make that process easier.
Instead of relying on a paper turn list, whiteboard, or receptionist memory, Certxa gives your salon a real-time system for managing walk-ins and assigning customers to the right technician.

## What Is a Salon Turn System?
A salon turn system organizes your walk-in customers and helps determine which customer should be served next.
But for a nail salon, simply putting customers in a numbered line isn't enough.
A customer waiting for a pedicure shouldn't necessarily be assigned to a technician who only performs manicures. A customer requesting Gel-X may need a technician qualified to perform that service.
Certxa takes those differences into account.
When a walk-in is entered into Certxa, the customer's requested service becomes part of the turn information, helping your staff make a better technician assignment.

The customer then enters the salon's turn queue.

Technician A: Manicure + Pedicure Technician B: Manicure only Technician C: Pedicure only
Your next customer is waiting for a pedicure.
Certxa can help identify the technicians who are actually eligible for that service instead of treating every available technician the same.
